_comment: OMN-18836. The watchlist is DATA, not a Python literal, so adding a
repository the day its own `push: branches: [dev]` trigger lands is an
edit to this file and nothing else. scripts/ci/dev_head_red_alert.py
reads it and carries no repository slug of its own; a test asserts that.
A repository belongs here only once its ci.yml actually triggers on a
push to `dev`. Listing one that does not produces `no_completed_run`
every tick forever, which is a false quiet rather than a signal.
Measured 2026-09-19 at origin/dev: omnibase_infra gains the trigger in
omnibase_infra#3842 (OMN-18835); omnimarket and omniclaude lack it and
are added when theirs land; omnibase_core already has it but its push
runs carry a separate known red (OMN-16641) and it is NOT added until
that is closed, because a watchlist entry that is always red is an alarm
